cells.forex: Often modest day to day for major pairs, but releases and policy surprises can bring sharp moves.
cells.stocks: Varies by company and sector; company news such as earnings can move a share a lot in one day.
cells.penny_stocks: Can be extreme: large daily swings, sudden spikes and falls, and gaps.
cells.commodities: Can be high; supply news, inventories and weather-type events can move prices quickly.
cells.futures: Follows the underlying, but leverage makes each move large compared with the margin.

caveat: [[volatility|Volatility]] changes over time and with conditions. A calm period says little about the next one, and leverage turns a small move into a big result.
